# Deploy to Supabase

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Apply migrations, deploy Edge Functions, and push config to a Supabase project

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-supabase@v1
  with:
    access-token: # Supabase access token (`SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`, from Account → Access Tokens).
    project-ref: # Target project ref (the subdomain in your project URL).
```

## How it works

Push migrations, Edge Functions, and project config to a Supabase project.

Covers the three things a Supabase deploy actually consists of, each independently
switchable so the same action serves "migrations only" preview environments and full
production releases:

  • `migrate`   — `supabase db push`, applying anything in supabase/migrations not yet
                  recorded in the remote schema_migrations table.
  • `functions` — `supabase functions deploy`, either a named list or every function.
  • `config`    — `supabase config push`, syncing supabase/config.toml (auth providers,
                  API settings) to the remote project.

Migrations run before functions on purpose: a function deployed against a schema that
hasn't been migrated yet fails at runtime, whereas the reverse ordering is safe for
additive migrations.

`dry-run` runs `db push --dry-run` and skips every mutating step, which makes this action
usable as a PR check that shows what a merge would apply.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `access-token` | **yes** | — | Supabase access token (`SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`, from Account → Access Tokens). |
| `project-ref` | **yes** | — | Target project ref (the subdomain in your project URL). |
| `db-password` | no | `""` | Database password, required for `db push`. |
| `migrate` | no | `true` | true to run `supabase db push`. |
| `functions` | no | `""` | Edge Functions to deploy: `all`, a comma-separated list of names, or empty to skip. |
| `function-secrets` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` secrets set on the project before functions deploy. |
| `no-verify-jwt` | no | `false` | true to deploy functions with JWT verification disabled (public webhooks). |
| `config` | no | `false` | true to run `supabase config push`. |
| `seed` | no | `""` | Path to a SQL file executed against the remote DB after migrations. Empty to skip. |
| `dry-run` | no | `false` | true to show what would be applied without changing anything. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory containing the `supabase/` folder. |
| `supabase-version` | no | `latest` | Supabase CLI version. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `migrations-applied` | Newline-separated migration versions applied (empty on a dry run). |
| `functions-deployed` | Comma-separated function names deployed. |
| `project-url` | The project API URL (`https://<ref>.supabase.co`). |
